comment: Named search areas of the village world, metres relative to the UAV base (takeoff point). The flight altitude is fixed at 6 m: that is the horizontal slice the lidar maps, and it is above the broken walls and below the standing structures. 'village' means the disaster district (both damaged buildings), not the whole settlement.

collapsed_building.description: the large collapsed multi-storey building in the centre of the village

damaged_house.description: the partly collapsed house east of the collapsed building

disaster_district.description: the disaster district: the collapsed building and the damaged house next to it

market_square.description: the market square north of the collapsed building
